settings.title: Settings
settings.create_folder_per_wallpaper: Create a folder for each wallpaper
settings.create_folder_per_wallpaper_desc: Local wallpapers use the source folder name. Manual extraction uses the .pkg filename without the extension.
settings.image_only_desc: Extract images and videos. Turn on “Keep .tex files” to keep texture files as well.
settings.no_convert_desc: Keep textures in their original format without converting them to images.
settings.flatten_structure_desc: Put extracted files directly in the output folder.
settings.overwrite_existing: Overwrite files with the same name
settings.overwrite_existing_desc: Replace matching files in the output folder with the extracted files.
settings.open_after_extract_desc: Show the output location in File Explorer after a successful extraction.
settings.open_after_import_desc: Open the project folder in File Explorer after importing into the wallpaper editor.
settings.glass_effect_desc: Give interface panels a translucent, blurred background.
